property_summary: For every input (identifier, time, ancillaryData) the reference contract's getPrice(view) does not always return a negative value - specifically it never returns -1 for all inputs, whereas the mutant returns -1 for some inputs making getPrice(...) equal to -1 while the reference does not (the test checks that a call to getPrice(...) can return a value different from -1 in the reference but the mutant always yields -1 for at least some fuzzed args).
change_summary: Changed getPrice from an empty body to return a constant negative price of -1 (int256 -1).
